changelog: New voice command: say 'duplicate last paragraph' or 'repeat last paragraph' (or 'শেষ অনুচ্ছেদ ডুপ্লিকেট করো' / 'শেষ অনুচ্ছেদ আবার লিখো') alone while dictating and the last paragraph is written again right after itself — handy for repeating a block, an address or a notice without re-dictating it. Undo removes just the copy, and the clipboard is never touched (73 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
